insights.one_liner: Axelera AI is an Eindhoven AI-chip startup that just launched its second chip and an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: Calls itself 'not your regular deep-tech company', building a next-generation AI hardware platform.
Based in Eindhoven, where its open software internship is located.

open.text: AXELERA AI B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one open job here, a software engineering internship, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Launched its second-generation 'Europa' AI chip and won AI factory supply deals.
Its chips are validated in Dell and Supermicro servers.
Says it more than quadrupled its global partner network in its first year.

worth_knowing.text: Is aiming for a US stock market listing within three to five years.
